products.summary: The cheapest no-fee doorbell we found that keeps its recordings inside the house: the included aosuBase Mini plugs in indoors and acts as the chime, the Wi-Fi bridge and the recorder, so a stolen doorbell does not take the footage with it.
products.fit: Homes that want a chime and indoor recording in one box for under $100 and will not pay a monthly plan. Best when the base can sit between the router and the door.
caveats: You must add a microSD card (up to 128 GB) to the base before it records anything.
2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only; keep the base within a room or two of the door.

Package and familiar-face detection are paid cloud features; person detection is free.

caveats: Costs $40 more than the Pro; the extra buys radar detection, 5MP and wired power, not more battery.
